name: V-Marc India Ltd
tagline: EXCLUDED - confirmed SEBI enforcement action for fraudulent stock-price manipulation by the promoter/MD and connected entities (re-verified 2026-09-02, exclusion stands)
business_overview: V-Marc manufactures PVC insulated wires & cables (NSE Emerge/SME listing, Apr 2024; XLPE/PVC cables, aluminium/copper conductors, largely to state DISCOMs / power utilities out of Uttarakhand). Headline fundamentals are exceptional (ROCE/ROE ~41%, 5yr profit CAGR ~76%, median 10yr sales growth ~37%), and Q1FY27 was a large beat (revenue from operations +102% YoY, PAT +163% YoY to ~Rs 28.5 Cr). None of this is decisive because the investment case is overridden by a confirmed regulatory finding below.
fundamentals_table: 5yr profit CAGR ~76%; 10yr median sales growth ~37%; Q1FY27 revenue +102% YoY
fundamentals_narrative: Fundamentals look exceptional on the surface, but SEBI confirmed an order (interim Feb 2024; confirmatory order 26-Jul-2024, with modifications) against 12 entities - including V-Marc's own promoter/Managing Director Vikas Garg and former Whole Time Director Sandeep Kumar Srivastava - for fraudulent, manipulative trading in the company's own scrip, orchestrated with a market operator (Prijesh Kurani) using connected trading accounts. SEBI impounded ~Rs 6.30 Cr of illegal gains and banned the 12 entities from the securities market. Vikas Garg's SAT appeal was against the interim order; SAT directed SEBI to pass a reasoned order, which SEBI did (the confirmatory order). RE-VERIFICATION (2026-09-02): triggered by a Sovrenn Discovery cross-check flagging the Q1FY27 beat (+102% revenue / +163% PAT YoY). A single strong quarter does not touch a confirmed SEBI fraud finding against the sitting promoter/MD. One WebSearch found no 2026 development vacating or overturning the 26-Jul-2024 confirmatory order - it stands. Exclusion rationale is unchanged.

No later reversal found as of 2026-09-02.
bear_case: Confirmed SEBI enforcement action for fraudulent stock manipulation directly implicating the company's promoter/MD and a former Whole Time Director - a company-management-level finding, not a peripheral or unrelated-party issue - and still standing as of 2026-09-02

Additional governance yellow flags independently noted by the community (frequent CFO turnover, below-market auditor fees, an unusually low-paid senior executive) compound rather than offset the SEBI finding
Elevated leverage (D/E ~0.92x) for a sector where peers typically run lower
A very strong Q1FY27 print (+102% revenue / +163% PAT YoY) does not change the governance verdict and, given the manipulation history, invites scrutiny rather than confidence
verdict_headline: Exclusion re-verified and unchanged - a confirmed SEBI finding of promoter/management-level stock-price manipulation overrides otherwise strong (and now accelerating) headline fundamentals
verdict_reasoning: Re-verification prompted by the Q1FY27 beat (Sovrenn Discovery cross-check). Per this project's ground rules, a confirmed active SEBI enforcement action against company management triggers an automatic EXCLUDE, regardless of any trusted-thread signal or fundamental quality, and is never overridden by a strong quarter

One WebSearch confirmed the 26-Jul-2024 SEBI confirmatory order still stands with no 2026 reversal; the specific finding - fraudulent trading in the company's own scrip involving the promoter/MD - goes to the heart of management integrity, which no fundamental metric can offset
